terminology.cloud_coordination_plane: Persistent TellMeN0TE + N0TE external coordination role. It is not N0TE and it is not the N0TE build harness.
terminology.n0te_build_harness: Temporary construction machinery that selects, builds, diagnoses, red-teams, verifies and closes bounded N0TE implementation work.
terminology.runtime_truth: Registry lifecycle describes semantic/governance posture. Scheduler enabled state, execution claim and health are separate observed runtime facts and must never be inferred from lifecycle=ACTIVE.

runtime_state_contract.rule: When runtime liveness matters, query the actual executor surface and reconcile the observation. A stale ACTIVE registry row may not be represented as a running process.

actors.purpose: Verify governance, full regression and staged consumer smoke on each relevant exact head and publish a canonical supervision observation.
actors.reason_running: A repository event supplied a head whose governance and product evidence must be independently verified.
actors.wake_condition: GitHub push to main or pull_request event for a new repository head
actors.retirement_condition: A versioned replacement verifier is registered and this actor is explicitly retired.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Verify the current exact head and emit supervision evidence.
lifecycle.last_observation: Each repository head requires fresh cross-platform governance and product evidence; previous runs are historical only.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: A registered GitHub push to main or pull_request event supplies a new exact head.

actors.purpose: Select and bound only currently justified N0TE construction work, then make construction dormant at stable operation when no justified construction remains.
actors.boundary: Temporary build harness machinery. It may reference N0TE requirements but does not own N0TE product semantics, artist meaning or permanent cloud coordination.
actors.reason_running: No N0TE construction is currently selected. The bounded UX-01 context-lifecycle increment and inherited Windows blocker are closed, so the build-harness coordinator is dormant until whole-portfolio selection produces a new dependency-ready receipt.
actors.wake_condition: A globally selected dependency-ready N0TE outcome is bound to a fresh active receipt, or fresh contradictory evidence requires explicit reactivation.
actors.retirement_condition: At STABLE the build-harness coordinator is dormant; a superseding build harness may explicitly retire this actor.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Close UX-01-CONTEXT-LIFECYCLE-01 and the inherited Windows exact-head blocker after verified cross-platform evidence.
lifecycle.last_observation: Exact head e9e80f3851f9d0cc9fac058408a36601d4134a54 passed Linux, Windows and macOS governance, full regression and staged consumer smoke. UX-01 is PRESERVED and no successor build work was auto-selected.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: Explicit whole-portfolio selection creates a new dependency-ready N0TE increment and active bounded receipt.

actors.purpose: Operate the single cloud-side TellMeN0TE + N0TE coordination plane: reconstruct live authority, semantically deduplicate differently worded outcomes, reconcile Drive/GitHub/provider truth, route and execute safe connected work, invoke due bounded subroutines, surface material unknown-unknowns and preserve local/cloud handoffs without multiplying independent watchers.
actors.boundary: Persistent coordination plumbing around TellMeN0TE, ChatGPT and N0TE. It is not N0TE, not the N0TE build harness and not a universal executor.
actors.reason_running: The portfolio needs one persistent external coordinator so routine continuation, drift detection and cross-surface follow-through do not require the user to reconstruct context or supervise multiple overlapping cloud workers.
actors.wake_condition: Hourly scheduled wake, material authority/provider change, or a due bounded internal audit.
actors.retirement_condition: A proven replacement local+cloud coordination plane owns the same authority surfaces and this actor is explicitly retired; temporary stability makes it quiet, not nonexistent.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Consolidate previously separate external artist, knowledge and standards watchers into one canonical cloud coordination role.
lifecycle.last_observation: One cloud coordination role is canonical; actual scheduler liveness must be observed from the external automation runtime and is not implied by this row.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: When scheduler_enabled is observed true: next hourly wake, material cross-surface state change, or due internal audit.

observability.observation_contract: Every material action or reconciliation retains the exact observed repository/provider/runtime state and suppresses repeat work against unchanged evidence.

actors.purpose: Execute or delegate one exact currently selected bounded N0TE construction receipt when explicitly reactivated by the build harness with actionable current evidence; never operate as an independent always-on lane.
actors.boundary: Temporary/on-demand build executor. It is not N0TE and does not own permanent coordination or product semantics.
actors.reason_running: The executor is deliberately dormant because its external schedule is disabled; construction selection remains owned by canonical governance, which may reactivate it only with a current bounded task.
actors.wake_condition: Explicit build-harness delegation against a fresh exact head, active receipt and concrete dependency-ready action.
actors.retirement_condition: Construction lifecycle becomes STABLE with no foreseeable on-demand execution need, or a proven replacement build executor is explicitly registered.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Preserve a bounded build-executor contract while removing the independent scheduled construction loop.
lifecycle.last_observation: The ChatGPT N0TE Build Worker automation is disabled and must not be represented as an independently active background actor.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: Explicit current-head delegation from the build harness after exact evidence is consumed.

observability.observation_contract: At most one attempt per unchanged head/receipt/blocker; every reactivation/action/delegation is attributable to explicit current evidence.

orphan_policy: Any autonomous actor without a registered parent, reporting path, purpose, current reason, bounded failure policy, allowed mutations, wake/retirement conditions and observation contract is a governance failure.
terminal_policy: No actor may create successor work merely to remain active. N0TE build-harness construction terminates at STABLE when no currently justified work exists; the cloud coordination plane may remain persistent and quiet because it serves ongoing portfolio operations rather than perpetual construction.
